A few things to know

How do I reserve a residence?

Select a residence and complete your stay enquiry. Review your message, then open WhatsApp and send it to Dwell. Our team will confirm availability, pricing and next steps.

What is the minimum stay and price?

Olive Suites has a two-night minimum at ₦80,000 per night, plus a ₦30,000 refundable caution fee per stay. Two nights total ₦190,000 including the caution fee. Confirm refund terms and any optional service costs with Dwell before reserving.

Can I arrange an extended stay or special requests?

Share your dates and requests in your enquiry. The team will discuss suitable options, service availability and any additional costs with you.

Are these photos of the residences?

These are illustrative images while residence photography is being prepared. Ask for current property photos and complete details before reserving.
